neighbours.label: what a garment or household product is made of and how (leather, canvas, latex, double-breasted, hand weaving), as opposed to other details about the same products (price, colour, where sold)
fire: He bought a pair of leather boots for the winter.
The bag is crafted from heavy waxed canvas.
This mattress is made of natural latex and wool.
She wore a double-breasted coat to the dinner.
The rug is hand knotted by skilled weavers.
The sofa is covered in soft Italian suede.
This shirt is made from 100% organic cotton.
The belt has a solid brass buckle and stitched edges.
quiet: He bought a pair of cheap boots for the winter.
The bag is sold online for forty dollars.
This mattress is delivered on Monday and Friday.
She wore a dark blue coat to the dinner.
The rug is beautiful and lasts for many years.
The sofa is on sale at the local store.
This shirt is available in red and green.
The belt has a two-year warranty and free returns.

short: what a product is made of and how
notes: Card: ' hand' x3, 'Hand' x2, ' wears' x2, ' leather' x2, ' a', ' be'. Output promotes ' tailor', ' Custom', ' inner'. Probes: ' leather' 0.73, '100%' before canvas 0.46, latex list 0.44, ' double' 0.43, ' hand' 0.27; folk singing 0.02, 'sold for ten dollars' 0.06, 'two-storey' 0.02, 'red, blue and silver' 0.00. ' be' and ' and' on the card are not explained.
